'''2010 US West Nationals Day 2 Jan Westergard DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Jan Westergaard
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
